title: Dreamcatcher
description: While staying at a cabin in the woods, telepathic friends (Thomas Jane, Jason Lee) confront aliens that are being hunted by the military.

title: Deep Cover
description: An undercover officer (Larry Fishburne) hooks up with a lawyer (Jeff Goldblum) who deals drugs for a West Coast cartel run by a foreign diplomat.

title: Lady in the Water
description: A building manager rescues an enigmatic young woman and learns that she is a "narf," a character from a bedtime story, who is trying to return to her world.

title: Spies Like Us
description: Two clumsy bureaucrats (Chevy Chase, Dan Aykroyd) are trained as spies, then sent to Pakistan to create a diversion.

title: Mr. Nice Guy
description: A gangster (Richard Norton) and his goons chase an ordinary guy (Jackie Chan) who helped a TV reporter (Gabrielle Fitzpatrick) escape their clutches.

title: Alien Autopsy
description: In the 1990s two men (Ant McPartlin, Declan Donnelly) produce a fake video that purports to be footage of an alien autopsy.

title: Best Friends
description: Hollywood screenwriters (Burt Reynolds, Goldie Hawn), happy as lovers, unwisely get married and go east to meet their in-laws.

title: Beyond the Poseidon Adventure
description: Salvagers (Michael Caine, Sally Field) seeking cash and a madman (Telly Savalas) seeking plutonium are trapped with survivors in an upside-down ocean liner.

title: Mama's Boy
description: A 29-year-old slacker (Jon Heder) who still lives with his mother (Diane Keaton) takes action when a self-help guru (Jeff Daniels) threatens his perfect world.

title: Chaos Theory
description: After his wife (Emily Mortimer) plays a prank on him, an efficiency expert (Ryan Reynolds) finds himself subject to the random nature of life.

title: Mr. Nanny
description: As a favor to his former trainer (Sherman Hemsley), a retired wrestler (Terry "Hulk" Hogan) takes a job as a computer tycoon's (Austin Pendleton) bodyguard.

title: Before Sunrise
description: An American (Ethan Hawke) and a Frenchwoman (Julie Delpy) meet on a train and spend a romantic day and night in Vienna.

title: Midnight Cabaret
description: Satanic aspects of a Broadway show are reflected in the life of an actress (Laura Herrington) who is in it.

title: The Bonfire of the Vanities
description: A Wall Street tycoon's life becomes a shambles when an unscrupulous journalist implicates him in a hit-and-run accident.

title: Pennies From Heaven
description: A sheet-music salesman (Steve Martin) escapes his wife, girlfriend (Bernadette Peters) and the Depression through his songs.

title: Joe Versus the Volcano
description: A dying man (Tom Hanks) meets three women (Meg Ryan) on his way to Polynesia, where a tycoon (Lloyd Bridges) expects him to jump into a volcano.

title: Dungeons & Dragons
description: Evil Mage Profion (Jeremy Irons) seeks Empress Savina's (Thora Birch) magic scepter in his quest to overtake the kingdom of Izmer for his group of magic users.

title: Overnight Delivery
description: A college student must prevent an impending disaster when he erroneously sends a poison-pen letter to his girlfriend.

title: Message in a Bottle
description: A woman (Robin Wright Penn) learns that the author of a romantic note that washed ashore is a shipbuilder (Kevin Costner) whose wife died young and tragically.

title: Ladyhawke
description: A medieval pickpocket (Matthew Broderick) learns the secret of a brooding knight (Rutger Hauer) with a hawk, and a beauty (Michelle Pfeiffer) with a wolf.

title: Revolution
description: A trapper (Al Pacino) joins the fight against the British in 1776 after his teenage son is tortured by a redcoat (Donald Sutherland).

title: Sphere
description: A psychologist (Dustin Hoffman), a biochemist (Sharon Stone), a mathematician (Samuel L. Jackson) and others investigate a large golden sphere deep in the ocean.

title: Moving
description: A yuppie (Richard Pryor) loses his job in New Jersey and moves his wife (Beverly Todd) and family to Boise, Idaho.

title: Addicted to Love
description: A man (Matthew Broderick) and a woman (Meg Ryan) meet by chance, then collaborate to spy on their exes, who are live-in lovers.

title: Vision Quest
description: A teenage wrestler (Matthew Modine) has trouble focusing on his training regimen when a worldly drifter (Linda Fiorentino) takes up temporary residence at his home.

title: Surf Ninjas
description: Two California surfers (Ernie Reyes Jr., Nicolas Cowan) try to overthrow a dictator as long-lost princes of a place called Patu San.

title: Preacher's Kid
description: A smooth-talking singer convinces a young woman (LeToya Luckett) to leave the security of her family, friends and church to join a traveling gospel show.

title: Forget Paris
description: Friends at a restaurant recall the romance of a yuppie couple (Billy Crystal, Debra Winger) who met in Paris four years before.

title: Beautiful Creatures
description: Teens (Alden Ehrenreich, Alice Englert) in a backwater Southern town encounter a history of family secrets and a curse that looms for one as she approaches her 16th birthday.

title: After the Sunset
description: An FBI agent (Woody Harrelson) thinks a master thief (Pierce Brosnan) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) will try to steal a valuable diamond from a cruise ship.

title: Matchstick Men
description: After meeting his daughter (Alison Lohman) for the first time, a con man (Nicolas Cage) and his partner (Sam Rockwell) try to swindle a boorish businessman.

title: The Hudsucker Proxy
description: A scheming executive promotes a mailroom worker to company president in the 1950s Manhattan.

title: Honeymoon in Vegas
description: A Las Vegas gambler (James Caan) wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's (Nicolas Cage) bride (Sarah Jessica Parker) during a convention of Elvis impersonators.

title: Conspiracy Theory
description: An obsessive New York cabby (Mel Gibson), in love with a government worker (Julia Roberts), learns that one of his suspicions is justified.

title: The Dukes of Hazzard: The Beginning
description: Bo (Jonathan Bennett), Luke (Randy Wayne) and Daisy Duke try to prevent Boss Hogg from seizing Uncle Jesse's (Willie Nelson) farm.

title: Wildcats
description: A famous coach's daughter (Goldie Hawn) coaches boys football at a city high school patrolled by dogs.

title: City Hall
description: The New York mayor (Al Pacino) and his idealistic deputy (John Cusack) cope with scandal generated by a policeman's accidental shooting of a black boy.

title: Fathers' Day
description: Two Californians (Robin Williams, Billy Crystal) seek a former girlfriend's missing son, each believing he is the father of the boy.

title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
description: A Belgian captain brings the ape-raised son (Christopher Lambert) of shipwrecked aristocrats home to his estate, his grandfather (Ralph Richardson) and Jane (Andie MacDowell) in Edwardian England.

title: The Golden Compass
description: In a parallel universe, young Lyra Belacqua journeys to the far North to save her best friend and other kidnapped children from terrible experiments by a mysterious organization.

title: Twilight Zone: The Movie
description: Four tales include a bigot (Vic Morrow), oldsters who find youth in playing kick the can, a misunderstood boy, and a terrified man (John Lithgow) on a plane.

title: Rumor Has It ...
description: A woman (Jennifer Aniston) sets out to find the truth after learning that the movie "The Graduate" may have been based on her family.
